description: S458 one reader: an enum-subset PARAMETER is a boundary zone. promote(r: Role oneOf([.Admin, .Editor])) is called with .Viewer, which is outside the subset: the entry check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT before the body runs, so @shown keeps "none". Before S458 codegen re-read parameter annotations with a regex that knew only number/string/integer/boolean heads, so an enum-subset parameter was never checked and .Viewer was accepted.
rationale: §53.9.2 table: a full `Role` value into a `Role oneOf([.Admin,.Editor])` parameter — "Yes — boundary narrow into the subset at the call site"; §53.15.2 Boundary row: a runtime membership check raises E-CONTRACT-001-RT.
